youtube.title: Why Most Option Buyers Lose Money (SEBI FY26 Data) #Shorts
youtube.description:
Why do most option buyers lose money even when the market moves their way? SEBI's FY26 study found about 87.7% of individual F&O traders lost money, and options made up about 92% of those losses. One big reason: time decay (theta) melts your option premium every day.

Numbers in this video:
• 87.7% of individual equity F&O traders made net losses in FY 2025-26; aggregate net loss about ₹91,685 crore (SEBI study, Aug 2026)
• Options accounted for about 92% of individual traders' aggregate losses (same SEBI study)

Have you ever been right on direction and still lost on an option? Tell us below.

You bought the option. The market moved your way. You still lost money? 🍦

SEBI's FY26 study: 87.7% of individual F&O traders lost money, and ~92% of those losses came from options.
An option is like an ice cream: the premium melts every day (theta).
The market has to move enough, and fast enough.
